settings.wefaxDecoder.label: WEFAX
cwViewer.wefax.idle: Listening for a chart's start tone, or press Start Now
cwViewer.wefax.lpm.label: LPM
cwViewer.wefax.lpm.hover: Lines a minute: Auto finds it from the chart's phasing lines; most stations send 120
cwViewer.wefax.ioc.label: IOC
cwViewer.wefax.ioc.hover: Index of cooperation, the chart's width: Auto finds it from the start tone; most stations send 576
cwViewer.wefax.startNow.label: Start Now
cwViewer.wefax.startNow.hover: Starts a chart now, without waiting for its start tone: for a chart already being sent
cwViewer.wefax.stop.label: Stop
cwViewer.wefax.stop.hover: Ends the chart being received here
cwViewer.wefax.trim.hover: Straightens a chart that slants: step it either way until the chart's upright lines stand straight (what came is drawn again). Click the value to set it back to 0
cwViewer.wefax.auto.label: Auto-Tune
cwViewer.wefax.auto.hover: Tunes the rig to each station's next chart by the published schedules, one chart after another. Tuning the rig by hand turns it off
cwViewer.wefax.auto.byHand: Auto-Tune off: the rig was tuned by hand
settings.wefaxDecoder.save.label: Save Charts
settings.wefaxDecoder.save.hover: Each chart is saved as a PNG in the folder below when it ends, however much of it came
settings.wefaxDecoder.folder.hover: Where charts are saved: click to open it
